description: This file defines the ShutdownReasonType interface for representing reasons for issuing a Shutdown command, including nested immutable classes and enums for known and unknown reasons.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonType
classes.description: An interface representing a reason for issuing a Shutdown command, extending CharSequence, with nested immutable classes and enum.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonType.Unknown
classes.description: An immutable class implementing ShutdownReasonType, representing an unrecognized shutdown reason with customizable name.

classes.name: ShutdownReasonType.Known
classes.description: An enum implementing ShutdownReasonType, representing predefined shutdown reasons such as 'purge-namespace' and 'purge-entities'.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static method in Unknown class to create an instance of ShutdownReasonType with a given name.

methods.name: forTypeName
methods.description: Static method in Known enum to retrieve a predefined ShutdownReasonType by its type name.
